Contract: week/day accept exactly two leading ASCII digits with value01..99;
dayo accepts three with value001..999. These functions perform lexical parsing:
week54/99, day32/99 and dayo367/999 succeed. Zero, short or non-digit prefixes
return None. Success preserves the original suffix pointer, length and bytes.
The complete blocker DAG and negative expectations are in `selection.json`;
callback/instance, NonZero value/type, product ownership and guarded result
transport must connect before claiming support.
